page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut ornament at the top, then a centred title block of three lines and a motto in small capitals below it. A library stamp sits in the centre, below the motto, and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: TU TEGIS IN TERRIS QUICQUID HONORIS ERAT.

page.notes: The top of the page carries a woodcut ornament with putti and a lion's mask; it has no text. A library oval stamp (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München) lies below the motto and is omitted. Faint show-through text from the reverse side is visible below the title and is omitted. The motto is set in small capitals, transcribed here in capitals with u for V as the rules require.
